title: Bryan Johnson's Protocol: lower RHR before bed, sleep, exercise, diet and sauna
summary: Bryan's Blueprint protocol: lower resting heart rate before bed as the single best lever, master sleep, exercise ~6 hrs/week, and eat a calorie-restricted, plant-heavy diet ending at noon. Also covers skin, hair, sauna, HBOT, measurement routines, his daily schedule and Rx stack.

principles.text: The single best health lever is lowering your resting heart rate before bed.
principles.quote: Lower your resting heart rate before bed.

principles.text: Finish your last meal about four hours before bed to lower RHR and improve sleep.
principles.quote: Eat your final meal/snack of the day four hours before bed

principles.text: Make sleep your top priority and plan your day around it.
principles.quote: You are a professional sleeper. Make sleep your #1 priority.

principles.text: Exercise about 6 hours a week, mixing strength, cardio, flexibility and balance.
Nutrition philosophy: every calorie must fight for its life; follow data, not diet camps.
principles.quote: My philosophy on nutrition is that every calorie must fight for its life.

principles.text: Beat bad habits by naming the self-destructive version of you and setting firm rules.
principles.quote: Make firm rules about what you will and won't do. **None is easier than some**.
